Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1313
Claimant:
Lorraine Allen
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
22 May 2025
The claim was opened after a report that the insured's vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection. The
claimant is represented by counsel, and all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office.
16 Jun 2025
Photos taken at the scene show damage that lines up with the described impact. The driver is named on the policy
and the coverage was in force at the time of loss.
26 Jun 2025
The police report and two statements confirm the claimant was in the vehicle, though no independent witnesses have
come forward. No earlier damage to the vehicle has been found in our records or in the inspection.
6 Aug 2025
The claimant reports neck and back strain, which is a plausible injury for a collision of this type. No prior injury to the
same body area is known from available history.
26 Aug 2025
Treatment has grown steadily over recent months, with more visits and new services added each month, well beyond
what this injury usually requires. The claimant has given the same account of the accident in every conversation so
far.
14 Oct 2025
Nothing in the file suggests the damage occurred before the coverage started. Review of the treatment billing against
typical care for this injury is ongoing, and the file will be referred for a further medical review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
